item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixed
- Tracks whose file extension doesn't match their format, such as an M4A download saved as .mp3, now split instead of showing "unsupported format".

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
First release.
Stems is a native macOS stem splitter for musicians, producers and DJs. Pull clean acapellas, drums or instrumentals out of any track, right on your Mac: no uploads, accounts or queues, and nothing else to install.
- Drop in a track or snippet: MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC or AIFF - 2 stems (vocals, instrumental), 4 (vocals, bass, drums, other) or 6 (adds guitar and piano) - Fast, or HQ for the highest quality with minimal artefacts - Save as WAV, MP3, AAC or Apple Lossless - Watch the stems grow, preview each one, then show them in Finder - Navigate it all from the keyboard - Updates itself (Stems › Check for Updates…)
Needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26.2 or later. The first split downloads the separation model (about 160 MB).
